_disclosure: ILLUSTRATIVE DEFAULTS for a synthetic merchant contract. These are NOT any provider's live pricing. This file is the seed of the circularity disclosed in PLAN.md: the generator produces data from this schedule and the FEE_OVERCHARGE / GST_MISMATCH / ZERO_MDR_VIOLATION detectors compare against it. Those rules therefore verify arithmetic and plumbing; they do not discover anything. Structural detectors (missing settlement, duplicate payout, duplicate capture, refund not reached, chargeback not re-credited) do not depend on this file and are the sound half of the taxonomy.
_units: All rates in integer basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). All flat amounts in integer paise. No floats anywhere.
_gst_rounding_policy_options: per_line = round fee to paise, then GST = round(18% of rounded fee). composite = compute GST on the unrounded fee and round once at the end. per_line matches how a tax invoice states fee and GST as separate rounded line items.

UPI.note: Zero-MDR by regulation. Any non-zero fee on a UPI leg is a rule violation by definition — see ZERO_MDR_VIOLATION, which is reported as a rule check and excluded from aggregate precision/recall.

DEBIT_CARD.note: Slab boundary is inclusive of the upper bound: exactly Rs 2000.00 takes the 40 bp slab.

EMI.note: Merchant-borne interest subvention is NOT a gateway fee and is never compared against this slab.

NETBANKING.note: Flat per transaction, per bank — not a percentage. Percentage-only fee logic silently mis-flags every netbanking row.

_tds_note: Tax deducted at source under s.194-O, withheld by the marketplace operator on the GROSS transaction value and remitted to the government. 100 bps = 1.00%. Illustrative for this synthetic merchant, not any provider's live rate. Unlike the gateway fee this is not the operator's revenue -- it reduces the payout but is recoverable by the merchant against its own tax liability, which is why it is a separate term in the settlement identity.
